author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: crenellated tower with a square notch between two merlons, an arched window, and a drawbridge plank raised on a chain from the tower's left side; reads as a castle gate. A first attempt with a narrow tower and a shallow round notch passed but did not read as a castle; the rejected drawing had no battlements.
omissions: The water wave is dropped (no 8-unit clearance under the raised plank inside the canvas); the two scalloped notches become one square notch; the drawbridge span is narrower than in the reference to give the tower room for battlements and window.
drawing_plan: SQUARE; tower x 16..42 open at the ground, battlements y 6 with notch 25..33 to y 12; window arch r4 at x 29, y 22..34; plank (16,42)-(6,30); chain (6,30)-(16,16).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'castle' square battlements and arched window.
